visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty one: the salad (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js train car with scrolling window scenery, box-built character, inbox / font picker / stats screenshots / page grid / reply / profile / discoverable-and-invite pages, a salad bowl and fork, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.8 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a brand wants her media kit, so she makes one on the train. Three hours on the font, a cover photo of her laughing at a salad, screenshots of stats already out of date, fourteen pages, and the reply is 'just send your three best videos'. Then YourBrand: a profile brands see, one line, top three videos, tracked views, Discoverable to brands, and brands can invite her. The salad was not funny.
